name: Heterotheca

project_scope.range: Texas native per Kew; project 3-county PASS not yet certified

look_here_first: Alternate leaves; often clasping upper leaves; spreading hairs and stalked glands on the stems and phyllaries; yellow ray and disk florets. Camphor odor is supportive, not diagnostic alone.
naming_caution: Heterotheca latifolia is treated by FNA as H. subaxillaris subsp. latifolia, not an independent canonical species. Pluchea camphorata is a separate camphorweed with non-yellow heads.
diagnostic_photo_plan: Close-up of upper leaf base and margins
Macro of stem hairs and glands
Ray and disk fruit comparison for final polish
